content_data.project_title: Mobile-First Content Strategy & Engagement Pilot for E-commerce
content_data.project_description: A pilot program to redefine our mobile content strategy, focusing on interactive storytelling and shoppable media experiences to drive audience engagement and conversion within the e-commerce sector.
content_data.timeline: Over the next 6 months, structured into 3 two-month phases.
content_data.project_lead: Amina Khan, Head of Content Strategy
objectives: Gather actionable user feedback to iterate and optimize content delivery and experience.
Establish scalable content formats and best practices for future global mobile expansions.
deliverables: Minimum of 10 high-engagement shoppable content pieces (e.g., interactive stories, short-form video series).
User feedback synthesis and recommendations for platform enhancements.
Scalable content creation workflow and toolkit for mobile-first media.
A/B test results and performance analysis reports for various content formats.
Comprehensive mobile content strategy document and editorial calendar.
